Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class NtlmAuthenticator

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.NtlmAuthenticator
public final class NtlmAuthenticator extends Object
NTLM (NTLMv2) authentication message construction per MS-NLMP. Pure and dependency-free: it builds the three handshake messages — NEGOTIATE (Type 1), CHALLENGE (Type 2, parsed) and AUTHENTICATE (Type 3) — and the NTLMv2 cryptographic chain that backs the Type 3 response.

The chain is, end-to-end, JDK-only:

  • NT hash = MD4(UTF-16LE(password)). The JDK ships no MD4, so it is hand-rolled per RFC 1320 in md4(byte[]).
  • NTLMv2 hash (NTOWFv2) = HMAC-MD5(NT hash, UTF-16LE(uppercase(user) + domain)) via javax.crypto.Mac "HmacMD5".
  • NTProofStr = HMAC-MD5(NTLMv2 hash, serverChallenge || blob) where the blob is the MS-NLMP temp structure (fixed bytes + timestamp + client challenge + target info). The full NTLMv2 response is NTProofStr || blob.
The timestamp and client challenge can be injected so the response is deterministic for tests; the crypto is verified offline against the MS-NLMP §4.2.4 known-answer vectors (see the test class).

All multi-byte fields are little-endian per MS-NLMP. This class only constructs/parses the messages; wiring it into the request pipeline is done elsewhere.

      public static String type1Message(String domain, String workstation)
      Builds the NEGOTIATE (Type 1) message and returns it Base64-encoded. Negotiates Unicode, NTLM and Request-Target (plus extended session security / target-info, required for NTLMv2).
